seo.title: How to Use Xposer AI
seo.description: A step-by-step guide for reporters: signing in, submitting an anonymous report, using the AI assistant, and reporting from your account.

howTo.title: How to use Xposer AI
howTo.lead: Everything a reporter needs: how to sign in, how to file a report without giving your name, how the AI assistant works, and how to follow a report through to its outcome.

overview.title: Two ways to report
overview.intro: Every concern you raise reaches the same compliance team and is handled with the same care. The only decision you have to make up front is whether your name travels with the report.

anon.title: Anonymous report
anon.body: No name, no email, no account. You get a report number and password, and those credentials are the only link between you and the report.
anon.best: Best when you would rather not be identified at all.

account.title: Account report
account.body: Sign in with the account your organization gave you. Your reports are collected in one dashboard, and the team can reach you directly with follow-up questions.
account.best: Best when you want easy tracking and faster follow-up.

control.title: Either way, you stay in control
control.body: Both routes are encrypted, both let you follow progress, and both let you exchange messages with the compliance team without revealing anything you have not chosen to share.

login.title: Signing in to your account
login.intro: Accounts are created by your organization — there is no public sign-up. If you have credentials, sign in from your organization's portal page.

s1.title: Open your organization's portal
s1.body: Your portal lives at a web address that ends in your organization's name, for example /{{slug}}. Use the link your organization shared with you, then choose Log in.

s2.title: Enter your username and password
s2.body: Type the username or email address your organization issued, then your password. Use the eye icon to reveal what you typed if you want to double-check it.

s3.title: You land on the right dashboard
s3.body: Signing in takes you straight to your dashboard. As a reporter that is your reports overview.

s4.title: No account? You can still report
s4.body: You do not need to sign in to raise a concern — skip ahead to <anon>anonymous reporting</anon>.

shot.alt: The Xposer AI sign-in screen with username and password fields
shot.caption: The sign-in screen. Passwords are never stored in readable form, and all traffic is encrypted.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Password resets are handled by your organization's administrator.

anon.title: Submitting an anonymous report
anon.intro: Anonymous reporting takes four steps: get credentials, choose a category, fill in the form, and submit. You are never asked for your name, email, or phone number.

s1.title: Open the anonymous report page
s1.body: Choose Report now in the top bar. You will land on Start Anonymous Report.

s2.title: Pick how your password is created
s2.body: Leave Auto-generate secure password selected — it produces a strong random password. Choose Create your own password only if you need one you can remember.

s3.title: Select “Get Secure Credentials”
s3.body: This creates an empty, unsubmitted report and issues your 8-digit report number plus its password.

shot.alt: Start Anonymous Report page showing password options and the Get Secure Credentials button
shot.caption: Stage 1. The “Take a tour” button replays a short walkthrough of this screen at any time.

save.title: Save your credentials before you go further
save.body: Your report number and password cannot be recovered or reset. Use Copy or Download on the next screen and keep them somewhere only you can reach.

s1.title: Save the credentials shown at the top
s1.body: <copy><copyIcon/> Copy</copy> puts both values on your clipboard; <download><downloadIcon/> Download</download> saves them as a text file.

s2.title: Pick the closest category
s2.body: Each category asks a different set of questions. Pick the category that matches your concern.

shot.alt: Select Report Type page showing report credentials and category cards
shot.caption: Stage 2. Your report number and password appear once, at the top of this screen.

stage3.title: Stage 3 — Fill in the form and submit

s1.title: Work through the steps
s1.body: The progress bar shows where you are. Required questions are marked with a red asterisk; everything else is optional.

s2.title: Attach evidence if you have it
s2.body: Documents, images, video and spreadsheets can be attached to the report.

s3.title: Submit
s3.body: When you submit, the report reaches the compliance team.

shot.alt: Multi-step anonymous report form showing step 1 of 3 with incident detail questions
shot.caption: Stage 3. Your report number stays visible at the top while you fill in the form.

track.title: Tracking your report and replying
track.intro: You can check your report's status and reply to the compliance team. All communication remains anonymous.

s1.title: Open “Track a report”
s1.body: It is reachable from the portal without signing in.

s2.title: Enter your report number and password
s2.body: Enter the report number and password you saved when you created the report.

s3.title: Read the status and any messages
s3.body: You will see the current status — Pending, In progress, Resolved — along with any questions from the investigator.

s4.title: Reply or add more information
s4.body: Anything you remember later, or any new evidence, can be added to the existing report rather than filed as a new one.

shot.alt: Anonymous Report Tracker page with report number and password fields
shot.caption: Tracking needs no account — only the credentials issued when you started the report.

ai.title: Reporting with the AI assistant
ai.intro: Submit your report with an AI assistant built for ethics and compliance reporting. You can use voice or text.

s1.title: Open the chat bubble
s1.body: It sits in the bottom corner of the screen, on every portal page.

s2.title: Choose how to report
s2.body: Anonymous Report keeps your identity out of it entirely. Account Report ties the report to your signed-in account — if you are not signed in, the assistant offers to take you to the login page.

s3.title: Create a secure ID
s3.body: For an anonymous conversation the assistant asks for the same password choice as the form: auto-generated, or your own. Select Create Secure ID and save the credentials it shows you.

s4.title: Describe what happened, in your own words
s4.body: Type into the message box and the assistant asks follow-up questions, filling in the report as you talk.

shotHome.alt: AI assistant panel offering Anonymous Report or Account Report
shotHome.caption: The assistant's opening screen: choose anonymous or account reporting.

shotPassword.alt: AI assistant Secure Credentials step with password options and Create Secure ID button
shotPassword.caption: Anonymous conversations start with the same credential step as the form.

voice.title: Speak instead of typing
voice.body: The microphone button turns on voice.

attach.title: Attach evidence
attach.body: The paperclip attaches documents, images and video to the report, up to 50 MB per file.

end.title: End the session
end.body: End Session clears the credentials from this browser. Make sure you have saved them first.

helper.title: The assistant is a helper, not the investigator
helper.body: It helps you get a complete report on the record. A human compliance officer reviews what you submit and decides what happens next.

account.title: Reporting from your account
account.intro: Signed in, everything you have raised lives in one place: statuses, history, and messages from the compliance team.

dashboard.title: Your dashboard
dashboard.counters: Counters at the top show how many reports you have filed and how many are pending, in progress, or resolved.
dashboard.myReports: My Reports lists each report with its status; switch between grid and list, or filter by status.
dashboard.activity: Recent Activity shows the latest movement on your cases.
dashboard.tour: Take a tour replays a guided walkthrough of the dashboard whenever you want it.

shot.alt: Reporter dashboard showing report counters, report cards and recent activity
shot.caption: The reporter dashboard. The sidebar carries Submit Report, My Reports, and an Anonymous Report shortcut.

s1.title: Choose “Submit Report”
s1.body: From the sidebar, or the Submit New Report button on My Reports.

s2.title: Select a report type
s2.body: Same categories as the anonymous route, with the number of steps shown on each card.

s3.title: Complete the guided form
s3.body: Identical multi-step form, minus the credential handling — your account already identifies the report as yours.

s4.title: Follow it from My Reports
s4.body: Status changes and messages from the compliance team appear against the report. No report number to keep safe.

shotSubmit.alt: Submit a New Report page with report type cards
shotSubmit.caption: Choosing a category for an account report.

shotReports.alt: My Reports page listing submitted reports with status badges
shotReports.caption: My Reports: search, filter by status or priority, and open any report.

unnamed.title: Prefer to stay unnamed on one particular concern?
unnamed.body: Even with an account you can use Anonymous Report at the bottom of the sidebar. That report is credential-based like any other anonymous submission.
